load_bearing_primary.interpretation: Speculative forecast only. A coding benchmark floor cannot move while a test-passing repair is mistaken for an identified one: this measures that the candidates which pass the same tests disagree, that agreement is not evidence (majority vote was wrong 3 times in 5), and ships the organ that asks the cheapest discriminating question and REFUSES when none exists. No obligation is discharged, no benchmark gain is claimed, no capability or independent credit is claimed.
